result.topic_en: Riemann expresses the gravitational/electrical potential of a continuous mass distribution, reduces it to the two-dimensional (cylindrical) case with a logarithmic potential written as the real part of a complex logarithm, and sketches the use of conformal maps and inversion in circles for masses distributed on cylinders.
